answer_1.quote: We study methods for Role Specified Open-Domain Dialogue (RSODD) systems. The goal of the system is conversing naturally with humans on open-ended topics while keeping conditions of given role.
answer_1.outputs: Dialogue responses for chatbots that care for senior citizens living alone

answer_4.quote: We ask the crowd workers to rate on a scale of 1 to 5 whether the generated dialogue satisfies several conditions
answer_4.guideline: For general dialogue generation ability, crowdworkers were asked to annotate if the dialogue is fluent and coherent. Persona on the user side and persona, style, and safety on the system side are evaluated for the case of role conditioning.
